mapper.select: WITH contest_info AS ( SELECT id, start_time, end_time FROM contest WHERE id = #{contestId} ), -- 先聚合赛时内的评测数据 judge_agg AS ( SELECT j.contest_id, j.display_id, SUM(j.status = 0) AS ac, COUNT(*) AS total, MAX(j.status = 0 AND j.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_accepted FROM judge j JOIN contest_info c ON j.contest_id = c.id AND j.created_time BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time GROUP BY j.contest_id, j.display_id ) SELECT cp.display_id, cp.display_title, cp.color, COALESCE(ja.ac, 0) AS ac, COALESCE(ja.total, 0) AS total, COALESCE(ja.is_accepted, 0) AS is_accepted FROM contest_problem cp LEFT JOIN judge_agg ja ON ja.contest_id = cp.contest_id AND ja.display_id = cp.display_id WHERE cp.contest_id = #{contestId} ORDER BY cp.display_id;
